title: How RingCentral builds AI-native work from engineering to ops
summary: See how RingCentral uses ChatGPT Work and Codex to accelerate AI product development and centralize operational intelligence across engineering and operations.
body: See how RingCentral uses ChatGPT Work and Codex to accelerate AI product development and centralize operational intelligence across engineering and operations.
summaryZh: RingCentral分享了其如何利用ChatGPT Work和Codex加速AI产品开发，并在工程和运营部门集中管理运营智能的实际案例。原始信息显示：See how RingCentral uses ChatGPT Work and Codex to accelerate AI product development and centralize operational intelligence across engineering and operations.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How RingCentral builds AI-native work from engineering to ops”。其重要性主要体现在：报道了RingCentral如何通过OpenAI工具进行AI原生工程与运营转型。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
